meta.semantics: Each case is one real response. 'query' holds the request's query parameters (stats: the entry filters; series: bucket, tz and the filters). Series buckets are the server's: date_trunc in 'tz' (weeks start on Monday), each 'start' the UTC instant of the bucket's local start, buckets without answers omitted. topic_id is pinned per topic (meta.topic_ids).
